prompt:
Create exactly ONE full-body transparent-background character master of the CAT6 Specialist from Mass Effect 3: Citadel, for Armax Relay Clash. Use the attached two inspected references as strict visual evidence. The first image contains three different models: copy ONLY the TALL MIDDLE figure, the Specialist with TWO ROUND CYAN EYE LENSES, a narrow cyan-tipped backpack antenna, a cylindrical shoulder/backpack module and FOUR cyan circular modules on the abdomen. Do not blend it with the left Heavy or the right Sniper. The second image is an actual ME3 screenshot of several Specialists and corroborates the native dark charcoal/gray camouflage, cyan optics, chest construction and apparatus. Preserve the native armor geometry, proportions, panel placement, little white insignia, straps, utility pouches, camouflage clothing, gloves, knee plates, shin plates and heavy boots of the middle reference figure. Match the tall, ordinary human build, with the exact narrow respirator and head silhouette; do not make a gigantic tank, a Cerberus soldier, or a generic sci-fi marine.

Composition: one complete Specialist alone, from top of the antenna to soles, standing front three-quarter in the same overall viewpoint as the middle figure in reference 1. Keep every antenna, shoulder cylinder, hand and boot within the image, with at least 10 percent transparent padding on all sides. Use a calm production reference stance: right hand near the side of the helmet as in the reference, left arm relaxed at the side, no handheld weapon. Equipment attached to the body remains exactly as visible in reference 1. This is a static unarmed body master; do not invent a firearm, energy shield or drone. Show the full legs and boots following the complete model view. The pale outlines are worn metal edges, not thick white outlines. Match the restrained game-texture look and materials, with neutral soft lighting; avoid glossy redesign, excessive photorealistic fabric detail, added battle damage or new surface panels. Strong clean silhouette, faithful fine details, cyan emitters small and controlled with no oversized glow.

Output exactly one character asset. Real alpha transparency throughout all surroundings, no opaque background, no floor, no scene, no text, no labels, no logo overlay, no border, no extra people, no duplicate view, no contact sheet, no ground shadow or painted checkerboard. Do not include any of the other figures, the backdrop, UI, vehicle, or weapons seen in the reference images. Preserve every supported detail rather than redesigning the character.
sourceLimitations: Port public du modèle complet : matériaux et éclairage du port non certifiés identiques au moteur ME3.
Capture finale native corroborant casque, équipement et palette ; autres directions, zones masquées et animation non inspectées.
Master sans arme : équipement de combat non complet.
